intended_object: Hard-coded rational interval data: a pair of rational intervals that bound the path coordinates for cell 58. It is cached so that the kernel-only verification of the Gerver sofa (Part B) computations can reuse it. I inferred this from the docstring ("exact cached path-coordinate pair for cell 58, sharing kernel reduction") and from the file's location in the KernelOnly/Core bundle.
explanation: The definition holds certificate data for a computer-assisted proof. It is a fixed pair of `RatInterval`s, and its endpoints are explicit large rational constants assembled with `naturalFromChunks`. The docstring says it exists to share kernel reduction across the verification of one cell. It has no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so it cannot be judged faithful or unfaithful to a standard notion. It is an implementation detail of the library's interval-arithmetic replay.
